rationale: The short thesis depended on price staying below the 5m 9-EMA with repeated closes near lows on rising volume. Price has now reclaimed the 9-EMA ($38.91) and the last five 1m candles are drifting higher on light volume while most of the favorable excursion has been given back. With the momentum trigger no longer intact, closing locks in the small gain and avoids risking a reversal toward VWAP/invalidation.
